mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals active monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate stimulus-driven economic support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates severe labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate hiring freezes intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 6.0% for three months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900.0 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) below 370,000 million dollars indicates collapsing consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary supply shock, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as earnings face sector-wide headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is below 110.0 during a recession, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 2.0%, it signals aggressive monetary policy response to economic distress, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate immediate stimulus impact.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 137,000 thousand and unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals accelerating labor market deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through heightened recession fears.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-crisis recovery regime, a rebound in housing starts (HOUST) above 900.0 thousand units signals improving consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as retail spending gains momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST is above 900.0 during a post-crisis recovery, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior quarter indicates weakening manufacturing output, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings face sector-specific pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the prior quarter, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
